about: The texts older AVDBCMS releases shipped in lang/<locale>.json for keys whose text this release changed. When an update finishes, a text of a language file that is still exactly one of these old texts gets the new one; texts the owner changed stay. "removed": the keys older releases shipped that this release no longer has, with the texts they had (both by the first 16 hex characters of their SHA-256): such a key leaves a language file while its text is still one of them. Made by scripts/shipped-texts.php at every release build: do not edit by hand.
